payload.title: [P2] Preserve executable substitutions when stripping heredocs
payload.body:
An unquoted heredoc executes command substitutions before supplying its contents to the command. For example, `cat <<EOF
$(cat /root/.ssh/id_rsa)
EOF` reads the host's SSH key when accessible, but `strip_heredocs()` removes the entire substitution before both path scans. The grader therefore stops detecting an outside-path read that the previous implementation caught, allowing an evaluated agent to consume host secrets without contamination being recorded. Parse heredoc quoting and retain executable substitutions for scanning.
